name: Sivir
title: the Battle Mistress

Q.name: Boomerang Blade
Q.description: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing (60/85/110/135/160 + 0.7×bonus AD + 0.6×AP) × (1 + (0.4×crit × (1×stat + -1))) to all enemies it cuts through. Hitting non-champions reduces the damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of 40%.
Q.summary: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.

W.name: Ricochet
W.description: For the next 4 seconds, Sivir gains 20/25/30/35/40% Attack Speed and her auto attacks are empowered to bounce to additional surrounding enemies dealing 0.4/0.425/0.45/0.475/0.5×AD physical damage each bounce for up to 8 bounces. These bounces critically strike if the attack generating them does.
W.summary: Sivir's next few basic attacks gain additional attack speed and bounce to nearby targets, dealing reduced damage while bouncing.

E.name: Spell Shield
E.description: Sivir creates a magical barrier for 1.5 seconds that blocks the next incoming enemy Ability. If an ability is blocked, Sivir restores 0.6/0.65/0.7/0.75/0.8×AD + 0.5×AP health and triggers Fleet of Foot.
E.summary: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir. She receives health and a burst of movement speed if a spell is blocked.

R.name: On The Hunt
R.description: Sivir rallies her nearby allies, granting them 20/25/30% Move Speed for 8/10/12 seconds. Sivir's attacks against champions while On The Hunt reduce the cooldown of her basic abilities by 0.5 seconds. Takedowns on recently damaged enemies refreshes the duration of the hunt.
R.summary: Sivir leads her allies in battle, granting them a surge of Move Speed for a period of time. In addition, Sivir's attacks reduce her spell cooldowns.

Passive.name: Fleet of Foot
Passive.description: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.
Passive.summary: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Wave-clearing marksman with a boomerang Q, ricocheting W and a spell shield. Safe, scaling ADC who wins through farm and team speed-ups, not lane kills.
strengths: E spell shield blocks a key ability and refunds mana
R speeds the whole team for engage or disengage
Easy to hold lane vs poke
weaknesses: Relies on items to deal damage
Vulnerable to all-in when E is down

curve.late: strong – wave clear and teamfight bounces

profile.curveNote: Wants E before trading into crowd control lanes.

Q.notes: Boomerang hits going out and back.

E.notes: Blocks the next enemy ability; doesn't block basic attacks.

profile.windowAgainst: E down: throw your key crowd control. Early levels before items.
